steps.what: Assemble result tables from the model run.
Draft the narrative around those modeling results.

loop.output: Narrative that quotes only those figures
loop.check: Analyst checks every figure against the table
loop.stop: One draft; a figure not in the table is deleted
loop.why_not_simpler: The story is prose, not a chart

steps.what: Check the narrative against the model run.
Present the modeling results to management.

tasks.design: Scheduled tables on the {BI} side are filled from the {DATA_PLATFORM} run. A narrative may quote only those figures, and the analyst checks them before the meeting. The presentation to management stays in the room.
tasks.previous_blocker: Packs were copied from solver output into slides the night before.
tasks.enabler_now: A certified table can refresh. The interpretation for this management question cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Saying what the result means for a decision the model did not contain.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst sees which figure the room will misuse.

ambition.what: The analyst decides before the meeting whether a figure is safe to show.

tasks.altitude: Presentations stay. The night-before copy shrinks. The analyst can withhold a figure that is not in the run.

reach.task: Show a reviewer a table that traces to the locked dataset
reach.learn: Which figures they refuse to put in a narrative

evidence.claim: A report assistant can answer questions on a prepared semantic model, and can misread a model that was not prepared.
Method choice, interpretation and advice to management stay with the analyst.

assumptions: Focal role is the operations research analyst. Boundary: from a finished model run to the management meeting. Choosing the model is out of scope.
Structured fields are measure name, value, unit and run id. The model run produces them. Fallback: the analyst types a figure the table missed, and marks it manual.
Test the {BI} semantic model and subscriptions before custom code. An unprepared model is not asked questions.
Upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours covers measure definitions.
unknowns: Whether management already has a subscribed report for this decision.
research_questions: What share of presentations reuse the same measures?
How often does the room ask for a cut that is not in the run?

incremental.description: Maintain certified measures used in the pack

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: each meeting needs a new cut, so the pack stays mostly manual. High case: measures are certified and only the talk stays. No individual staff scores are shown.

tasks.short: Define data requirements and validate them with statistical tests.

steps.what: Define the data requirements for the study.
Judge failures and tests that were not specified.
Record the validation result on the dataset.

tasks.design: The analyst defines the requirements. A configured extract on the {DATA_PLATFORM} gathers the fields, and a statistical engine runs only the tests the analyst named. Failures and unnamed tests stay a judgement. The engine computes; it does not choose the test.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requirements, extracts and tests were rebuilt in a workbook for each study.
tasks.enabler_now: Named tests and field lists can run again. Defining what is required is still the study design.
tasks.still_hard: A failed test that means the question was wrong, not the row.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst knows which failure is fatal for this decision.

ambition.what: The analyst decides, for each failed test, whether the dataset can still be used.

tasks.altitude: Less time on reruns. The analyst still sets requirements and signs the validation.

reach.task: Provide a governed extract with known fields and a refresh time
reach.learn: Which fields they will not leave undocumented

evidence.claim: In a measured trial, a model picked the statistical test and an engine computed it. Sample-size accuracy was 94.1 percent versus 55.4 percent, taking 4.0 versus 9.3 minutes.
At one company, text-to-SQL cut query writing from about 10 minutes to about 3, and the tool still invents tables.
The best agent in a benchmark solved 21.3 percent of enterprise text-to-SQL tasks.

assumptions: Focal role is the operations research analyst. Boundary: from a study question to a validation record. Building the source system is out of scope.
Structured fields are field name, source, test name and pass or fail. The analyst names the test; the engine returns the statistic. Fallback: a missing field is not imputed.
Test native extracts and saved queries before custom code. Do not let a text-to-SQL step write data.
Upkeep of 4 hours per 100 baseline hours covers test lists and field maps. The trial figures are not this organisation's result.
unknowns: Whether source systems already expose the required fields.
Who owns the extract when the source is outside the analyst's team.
research_questions: What share of studies repeat the same tests?
How often does a query invent a table name today?

incremental.description: Maintain field maps and the named test list

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: sources are messy and most tests were not specified in advance. High case: the field list and the named tests rerun, and only new failures need a person. Queries that invent tables are rejected.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Test models for adequacy and reformulate them when validation fails.

steps.what: Run stored validation tests on the models.
Compare output with the adequacy criteria.
Judge whether the models are adequate.

tasks.design: Stored tests run on the {DATA_PLATFORM} and a comparison marks gaps against criteria the analyst wrote. Adequacy and any reformulation stay with the analyst. The engine does not change the model.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each validation was a fresh workbook, and reformulation was mixed into the same sheet.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored test suite can rerun. Deciding that a model is adequate cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A model that passes the tests and still answers the wrong question.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst knows when to reformulate rather than explain the gap away.
tasks.altitude: Reruns shrink. Reformulation stays. The analyst can refuse to call a model adequate.

reach.role: Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers
reach.task: Keep a stored test that must pass before a change is kept
reach.learn: How they separate a passing test from permission to change the design

evidence.claim: In a measured trial, a model picked the statistical test and an engine computed it. Sample-size accuracy was 94.1 percent versus 55.4 percent, taking 4.0 versus 9.3 minutes.
Method choice, interpretation and advice to management stay with the analyst.

assumptions: Focal role is the operations research analyst. Boundary: from a model and a test suite to an adequacy judgement or a reformulation. Publishing the model is out of scope.
Structured fields are test name, criterion, result and pass or fail. The analyst writes the criterion. Fallback: a test with no criterion is not run.
Test the platform's saved jobs before custom code. A model may not pick a new test here.
Upkeep of 3 hours per 100 baseline hours covers the test suite when the question changes.
unknowns: Whether a validation suite already exists for the main models.
Who may accept a model that failed a criterion.
research_questions: What share of models have the same adequacy tests each cycle?
How often does reformulation follow a failed test?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: criteria change every cycle, so comparison and reformulation stay long. High case: the suite reruns and only failed models are reformulated.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare management reports that recommend solutions.

steps.what: Pull problem measures into the report shell.
Draft the problem statement from those measures.

loop.check: Analyst deletes any number not in the shell
loop.stop: One draft; a missing measure stops the line
loop.why_not_simpler: The recommendation is not a measure

steps.what: Recommend a solution in the management report.
Send the management report to the manager.

tasks.design: The {BI} shell refreshes certified measures. A draft problem statement may use only those numbers. The recommendation stays the analyst's, and the report is sent only after that recommendation is the one in the pack.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reports were assembled by hand, and a number could drift from the workbook.
tasks.enabler_now: Certified measures make the shell boring. The solution is still a judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Recommending a solution the measures do not force.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst chooses which problem is worth a manager's hour.

ambition.what: The analyst decides which problem is ready for a recommendation this week.

tasks.altitude: The writing of numbers shrinks. Recommendations stay. The analyst can hold a report whose numbers do not match the shell.

reach.task: Send a management pack that cites a certified measure
reach.learn: How they stop a narrative number that is not in the dataset

evidence.claim: A report assistant can answer questions on a prepared semantic model, and can misread a model that was not prepared.
A vendor case said a question tool cut manual data tickets by 72 percent and saved 200 analyst hours a month.
Article 4 has required AI literacy of staff since February 2025.

assumptions: Focal role is the operations research analyst. Boundary: from certified measures to a report sent inside the company. Implementing the solution is out of scope.
Structured fields are measure, value, period and problem id. The semantic model produces the value. Fallback: if a measure is uncertified, it is left out.
Test {BI} subscriptions before custom code. Do not ask an assistant questions of an unprepared model.
Upkeep of 3.5 hours per 100 baseline hours covers measure certification. The vendor ticket figure is not this team. Staff who use the draft need enough literacy to know it is a draft.
unknowns: Whether the measures management wants are already certified.
Who else must see the report before the manager.
research_questions: What share of the report is a repeating pack?
How often is the recommendation changed after the numbers move?

incremental.description: Certify and revise measures used in the report

approvals.approved_version: report version with the analyst's recommendation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: the question is new and certification is thin, so the shell saves little. High case: the pack refreshes and only the recommendation stays. The 72 percent vendor figure is not used as this team's saving.
